The weakly dominant strategy is to bid my true value: it avoids losses from overbidding (winning and paying above value) and avoids missed surplus from underbidding (losing when I should win). With three bidders and $0.1 increments, set bid to my exact value to ensure I win whenever the second-highest bid is below my value and pay that second-highest bid.
